chemistry-h3-q2.title: Falgalka 2NO(g) + O₂(g)
chemistry-h3-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h3-q2.material: Falgalka 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), marka la sameeyo habka xawaaraha bilowga, [O₂] la joogteeyay oo [NO] laba jibaarmay xawaaruhu wuxuu noqday 4 jibaar, [NO] la joogteeyay oo [O₂] laba jibaarmay xawaaruhu wuxuu noqday 2 jibaar. Waa maxay sharciga xawaaraha iyo wadarta darajada falgalkan?
chemistry-h3-q2.s.s1.prompt: Falgalka 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), marka la sameeyo habka xawaaraha bilowga, [O₂] la joogteeyay oo [NO] laba jibaarmay xawaaruhu wuxuu noqday 4 jibaar, [NO] la joogteeyay oo [O₂] laba jibaarmay xawaaruhu wuxuu noqday 2 jibaar. Waa maxay sharciga xawaaraha iyo wadarta darajada falgalkan?
chemistry-h3-q2.s.s1.explain: Marka $[\text{NO}]$ uu noqdo $2$ jibaar xawaaruhu wuxuu noqdaa $4$ jibaar, sidaa darteed $m=2$, marka $[\text{O}_2]$ uu noqdo $2$ jibaar xawaaruhu wuxuu noqdaa $2$ jibaar, sidaa darteed $n=1$. Sharciga xawaaraha waa $v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, wadarta darajada falgalka-na waa $2 + 1 = 3$ darajo.

chemistry-h3-q3.title: Falgalkan gaaska ah ee
chemistry-h3-q3.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h3-q3.material: Falgalkan gaaska ah ee exothermic ah wuxuu gaadhay dheellitir dynamic ah weel xidhan: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + kuleyl (ΔH < 0). Waa maxay xaaladaha ugu fiican ee la xakameeyo si loo kordhiyo soo-saarka ammonia (NH₃) xaaladda dheellitirka?
chemistry-h3-q3.s.s1.prompt: Falgalkan gaaska ah ee exothermic ah wuxuu gaadhay dheellitir dynamic ah weel xidhan: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + kuleyl (ΔH < 0). Waa maxay xaaladaha ugu fiican ee la xakameeyo si loo kordhiyo soo-saarka ammonia (NH₃) xaaladda dheellitirka?
chemistry-h3-q3.s.s1.explain: Maadaama ay tahay falgal exothermic ah ($\Delta H < 0$), heerkulka waa in la hoos dhigaa si falgalka hore ee kuleylka sii daaya uu u xoogaysto. chemistry-h3-c.title: [Astaamaha isku-darka ee xalalka
chemistry-h3-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h3-c.material: [Astaamaha isku-darka ee xalalka ee heerka sare] Kuwee ayaa ah dhammaan odhaahyada saxda ah ee ku saabsan astaamaha (colligative properties) ee xalka la qasiyay ee ay ku milmeen walxo aan uumiyoobi karin oo aan electrolyte ahayn? A. Kuma xirna nooca walaxda lagu milmay, waxay kaliya la socotaa tirada walxaha (molality). B. Cadaadiska uumiga ayaa ka hooseeya kan dareeraha saafiga ah, heerkulka karkarinta-na wuu kordhaa. C. Qaaciddada cadaadiska osmotic ee van 't Hoff waa Π = cRT, taasoo la mid ah isleegga xaaladda gaaska ku habboon.

chemistry-h3-q5.material: Isleegga kiimikada ee kala jabka sodium azide adag (NaN₃) ee ka buufiya airbag-ka 0.03 ilbiriqsi gudahood marka shil gaari dhaco waa 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Waa maxay sababta kiimikada ugu fiican ee falgalkan ugu habboon yahay soo-saarka gaaska airbag-ka?
chemistry-h3-q5.s.s1.prompt: Isleegga kiimikada ee kala jabka sodium azide adag (NaN₃) ee ka buufiya airbag-ka 0.03 ilbiriqsi gudahood marka shil gaari dhaco waa 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Waa maxay sababta kiimikada ugu fiican ee falgalkan ugu habboon yahay soo-saarka gaaska airbag-ka?
chemistry-h3-q5.s.s1.explain: Sodium azide marka ay goosato dhimbil korontada wuxuu isla markiiba ku kala jabaa gaas nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) oo aan dhib u ahayn jidhka kiimiko ahaanna aan falgalin oo tiro badan, wuxuuna si ammaan ah u ilaaliyaa dadka gaariga ku jira shilka.

chemistry-killer-12.title: Heerkul 25 °C, acetic
chemistry-killer-12.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-12.material: Heerkul 25 °C, acetic acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) waxay leedahay $\mathrm{p}K_a = 4.7$. Isku-dar 0.20 M $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ 100 mL iyo 0.10 M $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$ 100 mL si aad u sameyso buffer solution. Marka lagu daro 1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 10 mL, waa maxay pH-ka xalka? (Isbeddelka xoogga ee ka dhasha isbeddelka mugga saamayn kuma yeesho xisaabinta saamiga, isticmaal $\log 2 = 0.30$. Marka la qasayo NaOH wuxuu si buuxda ula falgalaa acetic acid.)
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: Heerkul 25 °C, acetic acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) waxay leedahay $\mathrm{p}K_a = 4.7$. Isku-dar 0.20 M $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ 100 mL iyo 0.10 M $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$ 100 mL si aad u sameyso buffer solution. Marka lagu daro 1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 10 mL, waa maxay pH-ka xalka? (Isbeddelka xoogga ee ka dhasha isbeddelka mugga saamayn kuma yeesho xisaabinta saamiga, isticmaal $\log 2 = 0.30$. Marka la qasayo NaOH wuxuu si buuxda ula falgalaa acetic acid.)
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Mole-ka bilowga. HA = 20 mmol, A⁻ = 10 mmol (pH-ka bilowga = 4.7 + log 0.5 = 4.7 − 0.30 = 4.4).
Tallaabo 2: NaOH 1.0 M × 10 mL = 10 mmol → $\mathrm{OH^- + HA \rightarrow A^- + H_2O}$, HA 10 mmol way yaraataa, A⁻ 10 mmol ayaa kordha. HA = 10 mmol, A⁻ = 20 mmol.
Tallaabo 3: Maadaama ay isla xalka ku jiraan, saamiga xoogga = saamiga mole = 2. pH = 4.7 + log 2 = 4.7 + 0.30 = 5.0.
Jawaab: 5.0 (d). (Jawaabaha khaldan: 4.4 waa pH kahor marka NaOH aan lagu darin, 4.7 waxaa si qalad ah loo xisaabiyay HA iyo A⁻ oo isle'eg noqday, 5.3 waxaa lagu xisaabiyay saamiga 4.)
chemistry-killer-12.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-12.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
